notes.title: Pretty Overseer - Dive into a Magical Romance Adventure!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281773/c95fb7cf461fa32864247e89903163abc2fe5089.gif[/img]

We're excited to introduce Pretty Overseer, an enchanting animated dating simulator set in a captivating anime-style world. As a young lieutenant in charge of magically gifted individuals within the confines of a military Academy, your journey is about to begin.

In Pretty Overseer, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of magic, romance, and the complex choices that define your path. Your mission is to oversee the correction of recruits who possess extraordinary magical abilities, but it won't be a walk in the park. Under the watchful eye of your mistress, Neoma, you'll maintain order, train recruits, and navigate a web of personal and professional relationships.

Choose your own path. Will you blindly obey the witch, or will you find your own way, exploring romance and intimacy along the way?

Your recruits possess immense magical potential, surpassing even your abilities. As their lieutenant, it's your duty to handle them with care, especially during moments of stress when their magic spirals out of control.

notes.title: 🚀 Support Our Project: Less Than 48 Hours Left! 🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281773/e5f39667d97d03e11883d8a65c9dbe7014a5bcfa.jpg[/img]

Hello backers and supporters! We're thrilled to see the incredible momentum our Kickstarter campaign has gained, but there's still time left to make an even bigger impact! With less than 48 hours remaining, we need your continued support to help us reach our stretch goals and bring our game to new heights.

To all those who have already backed us, we want to express our deepest gratitude. Your belief in our project has been invaluable, and we're humbled by the trust you've placed in us. You've played a crucial role in getting us this far, and we can't thank you enough.

For those who haven't yet supported us, now is the perfect time to join our community and be a part of something special. By backing our project, you not only help us bring this game to life, but you also gain access to exclusive rewards and experiences.

Thank you for your incredible support, and let's make this journey an unforgettable one!
